detail: Vikas Ratanlal Kataria HUF submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The disclosure is a public filing requirement triggered when an acquirer crosses specified thresholds (typically 5%, 10%, 15%, 25% etc.) in a listed company's shareholding, or when acquisition activity resumes after a public announcement. The filing does not itself reveal the shareholding percentage, acquisition cost, or timing, but marks a regulatory milestone that may precede an open offer or further disclosure.
